positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Use PHP to write Object Oriented code to enable engineers at Wayfair to write and run database tests. 

Notable projects:
- Docker Management Tool
   - Developed a web tool using PHP and React to facilitate management of testing Docker containers which allows engineers to quickly see important information about their container as well as the databases loaded on each container
   - Improved previous workflow for managing testing containers by removing the need to connect to a remote VM and running commands via command line and replacing it with an intuitive web tool that provides the same functionality through simple button clicks, increasing testing efficiency across Wayfair engineering
- Database Testing Framework Library Extraction
   - Led design meetings on most efficient way to extract the database testing framework out of the mono-repo and into its own library for use in decoupled applications as well as gaining the ability to leverage versioning to maintain cleaner code
   - Implemented the proposed design by extracting the database testing framework code out of the mono-repo and into a standalone library in its own repository and refactored legacy code to be up to par with current coding standards
   - Boosted development efficiency of testing tools team by facilitating faster code iterations, improved code quality by removing the need to support backwards compatibility, and increased code coverage in decoupled applications
- Command line program to create custom Docker image with pre-loaded databases
   - Built Bash program that given a configuration file with database information, creates a custom Docker image for the user containing the specified databases
   - Decreased testing latency for engineering teams that frequently run database tests against the same set of databases by removing the need to regularly install an empty container and restore the same set of databases
